name: Robosense Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Robosense Technology Co., Ltd is an investment holding company providing LiDAR and perception solutions in China and internationally. Its LiDAR products serve driver assistance systems, robotics, cleaning, industrial, logistics, public services and inspection uses. Its perception solutions include P6, an automotive-grade solid-state LiDAR sensor fusion solution, and a vehicle-to-road V2X solution.
